children: Peak Hill Phase II – Curley’s Additional Drilling Completed

Forgent plc (AIM: FORG), the Australian-focused critical and precious minerals explorer, is pleased to announce that the additional drilling programme at the Curley’s prospect within its 99%-owned Peak Hill Gold-Copper Project, announced on 15 September 2026, has now been completed.

A total of 12 additional holes were completed, at approximately 20-metre step-outs around the Phase I drilling programme intersection of 2m @ 3.68g/t Au, with the aim of extending the strike and continuity of the gold mineralisation.

The additional drill holes to the current programme were introduced following the Company’s site visit review of drilling to date, and brings the total already drilled to 56 holes and 2,771 metres (30 holes at Curleys and 26 holes at Cathedral).
Samples from the programme will now be submitted for laboratory analysis.
For further information on Forgent plc, visit the Company’s website www.forgentplc.com or contact:
Global Investment Strategy UK Ltd – Broker
Billy Clegg / Georgia Edmonds / Fergus Young

Forgent plc is an Australian-focused critical and precious metals exploration company focused on acquiring and advancing gold, copper and nickel assets with existing mineralisation, extensive historical datasets and clear pathways to value creation, supported by an experienced management and technical team.

The Company is strategically positioned to benefit from structural demand for copper, gold and nickel, driven by electrification, data centre investment, electric vehicle adoption and gold’s continued role as a safe-haven asset and central bank reserve holding.

Forgent’s portfolio includes Peak Hill, an advanced gold-copper exploration project; an option over Mount Sholl, a nickel-copper-PGE project with a JORC-compliant resource and significant exploration target; and Green Rocks, a copper-gold project with high-grade surface mineralisation.
